Security

A little care.
A safer connection.

Protect your information, recognise suspicious requests, and know where to turn if something feels wrong.

Good habits, from the start

Keep your information
in your hands.

01

Keep access private

Never share a password or one-time code. Use a unique password wherever you create an account, and sign out of shared devices.

02

Check before you click

Be cautious with unexpected links, downloads, or requests to sign in. Open the website yourself when you are unsure who sent a message.

03

Share only what is needed

Keep identity documents, financial details, and private contact information out of public profiles and social comments.

Understand the limits

Trust should be informed.

This website currently provides information and support links. It does not collect identity documents, process payments, or operate member accounts. We do not claim that profiles have been verified here or that a connection is risk-free.

Read our Privacy Policy ↗

Report a technical concern

Spotted something
that isn’t right?

If you notice a suspicious link, possible data exposure, or a weakness in the website, tell us privately.

Report a security issue

What to include

  1. The page address and a short description.
  2. What you expected and what happened instead.
  3. Your device, browser, and the approximate time.
  4. A screenshot with private information hidden, if useful.

Security questions

A few useful answers.

Someone asked for my password or code. What should I do?+

Do not share it. If you already shared a password, change it through the affected service’s official website and review its account-recovery options. Tell our team if the message claimed to be from Favorite Hearts.

Does HTTPS mean a person or payment request is trustworthy?+

No. An encrypted connection helps protect traffic in transit, but it does not prove that a person is genuine or that a request is safe. Check the website address and independently confirm unexpected requests.

Is a verification badge a guarantee of safety?+

No. A check can only establish what was checked at that time. Verification features are not active on this website, and no badge can guarantee someone’s intentions or future behaviour.

Where do I raise a concern about another person?+

Use our Trust & Safety guidance and contact support. If there is immediate danger, contact local emergency services rather than waiting for a website response.
